name: Relationships Are Like Rollercoasters
source:
Relationships are like rollercoasters. Sometimes, you turn upside down. Sometimes, you feel sick.

Watch a long-time friendship between two women degenerate when one of them gets a girlfriend.

[From [url=https://unicorncreates.itch.io/relationships-are-like-rollercoasters]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人际关系就像过山车。有时，你会颠倒过来。有时，你会感到不舒服。

看着两个女人之间的长期友谊随着其中一个有了女朋友而恶化。

[来自[url=https://unicorncreates.itch.io/relationships-are-like-rollercoasters]itch.io[/url]]
